table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PatientCode = P.PatientCode,
	Patient = P.Name,
	FName = P.FName,
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	RegdOn = P.Date,
	City = P.City,
	Address = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Address1, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Address2, ''))) ,
	Phone = P.Phone,
	MobileNo1 = P.MobileNo1,
	NationalIDCard = P.NationalIDCard,
	Gender = P.Gender,
	Age = P.AgeYears,
	Relation = R.Name,
	Doctor = (SELECT D.Name FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = P.DoctCode),
	SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Date = S.Date,
	InvTotal = S.InvTotal
FROM
	Patient P,
	Relation R,
	SaleLedger S
WHERE
	S.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND:ad_enddate AND
	S.PatientCode=P.PatientCode AND
	P.RelationCode = R.RelationCode
GROUP BY 
	P.PatientCode,
	P.Name,
	P.RegNo,
	P.FName,
	P.Date,
	P.City,
	P.Address1,
	P.Address2,
	P.Phone,
	P.MobileNo1,
	P.NationalIDCard,
	P.Gender,
	P.AgeYears,
	R.Name,
	P.DoctCode,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date,
	S.InvTotal
table.sort: date A, saleinvcode A, regno A, patient A
